findings.title: Unsupported actions/checkout runtime
findings.summary: actions/checkout@v4: This release predates the action's Node.js 24 runtime. GitHub no longer provides Node.js 20 on Actions runners.

constraints: Preserve checkout depth, credentials, submodule, and sparse-checkout behavior configured through action inputs.

steps.title: Upgrade the checkout action
steps.instructions: Change the uses reference to actions/checkout@v5 or a later supported major.

steps.title: Review checkout inputs
steps.instructions: Compare configured inputs with the target release and update renamed or changed options.

sources.title: Node 20 is no longer available in GitHub Actions

findings.title: Node.js 18 is end-of-life
findings.summary: compatibility range >=18 includes Node.js 18. Node.js 18 no longer receives security or bug fixes.

constraints: Keep package metadata, local version files, CI matrices, and deployment runtimes on a mutually compatible Node.js release.
Confirm native modules and production dependencies support the target Node.js major.

steps.title: Update the Node.js declaration
steps.instructions: Raise the reported engines or pinned runtime declaration to Node.js 22 LTS or later.

steps.title: Align runtime surfaces
steps.instructions: Update matching local version files, CI matrices, container images, and deployment configuration.

verification.purpose: Confirm the active Node.js runtime is supported.
Run the repository test suite on the target runtime when defined.
Verify the project builds on the target runtime.

findings.title: request is deprecated
findings.summary: request is declared in dependencies as 2.88.2; resolved: not found in a supported lockfile. The package is fully deprecated and no new changes are expected.
findings.replacement: Native fetch or a maintained HTTP client

constraints: Preserve request method, headers, authentication, redirects, timeouts, retries, proxy behavior, streaming, and response/error semantics used by each call site.

steps.title: Choose the target HTTP client
steps.instructions: Select native fetch or one maintained client whose behavior covers the affected request usages.

steps.title: Rewrite request usages
steps.instructions: Translate callbacks, options, response handling, errors, and streams at every reported import and call.

steps.title: Replace the dependency
steps.instructions: Remove request from package metadata and add the selected maintained client only if native fetch is insufficient.

verification.purpose: Run HTTP behavior and repository tests when defined.
Verify imports, types, and the build remain valid.
